title: Tidy hierarchy tree
intent: Show part of the Flare analytics hierarchy with a tidy node-link layout and direct class labels.

ai.create: Create a left-to-right tidy hierarchy from Observable's flat Flare name paths with one link per parent-child relationship, one dot per node, and direct class labels.
ai.maintain: Change the selected Flare rows while preserving the raw name field, stable path identity, mirrored branch and leaf labels, granular d3-hierarchy imports, and cast-free channels.
